title: Florida MathCounts
text:
The State Competition in Florida is held in Orlando. In Florida, the Countdown Round is official. The Ciphering Round is also present.

Some of the math legends in the Sunshine State include Jaedon Whyte (MATHCOUNTS Written 6th seed 2018, USAMO Winner, & more), Karthik Vedula (MATHCOUNTS Written 10th seed 2019), Michael Wei (Mathcounts Written 8th Seed 2022), Ashvin Sinha (MATHCOUNTS Written 2nd seed and 3rd seed CDR 2023), and Benjamin Jiang (MATHCOUNTS Written 8th seed and CDR Champion 2024).

Past Florida Mathcounts Team Members[edit]

  • 2025 (6th Place Team): Arnav Bhatia, Gnaneswar Peddesugari, Edwin Gao(13), Rananjay Parmar. Coach: Jake Frazer
  • 2024 (5th Place Team): Benjamin Jiang(1), George Paret, Daniel Li, Daniel Wei. Coach: Jessica Merrick
  • 2023 (2nd Place Team): Eric Gao, Benjamin Jiang(13), Ashvin Sinha(3), Roger He. Coach: Pushpa Kurian
  • 2022 (8th Place Team): Kevin Liu, Aaryan Vaishya, Michael Wei(8), Anish Patel. Coach: Adeliny Mudrauskas
  • 2019 (2nd Place Team): Wesley Chen, Karthik Vedula(10), Aaron Hu, Razzi Masroor. Coach: Pushpa Kurian
